questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

How long have you __being seating__ on this bench?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'****been sitting​.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part** 'being seating​' **is incorrect as it is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Being** refers to the present or continuous action, while **been** refers to the past or to something that started in the past but is continuing into the present.
 
• The meaning of the verb **'seat' **is to sit down.
 
 
• Example: *Please be** seated**.*
 
 
 
• ​The meaning of the verb **'sit' **is to put somebody into a sitting position; make somebody sit down.
 
 
• **Example**: *He picked up his daughter and **sat** her down on a chair.*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore, the use of 'being seating' in the sentence should be replaced with 'been sitting' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• ​​The correct sentence__:* **How long have you **been sitting** on this bench?*

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• The past indefinite tense, also known as simple past tense, is used to indicate a finished or completed action/task that occurred/happened at a specific point in time in the past. 

 
 
• Structure: Subject + verb in the past form + . . . . . + adverb of time + . . . . .
 
• Example: *I ate a mango a few minutes ago.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• भाग 'being seating​' गलत है क्योंकि यह व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है।
 
• Being वर्तमान या निरंतर क्रिया को संदर्भित करता है, जबकि **Been **अतीत या किसी ऐसी चीज़ को संदर्भित करता है जो अतीत में शुरू हुई थी लेकिन वर्तमान में जारी है।
 
• **'Seat'** क्रिया का अर्थ बैठना है।
 
 
• Example: *Please be seated.*
 
 
 
• क्रिया **'Sit'** का अर्थ किसी को बैठने की स्थिति में रखना है; किसी को बैठाओ।
 
 
• Example: *He picked up his daughter and sat her down on a chair.*

__
 
• The part 'yet living' is incorrect as it is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The meaning of the word** 'yet'** is used with negative verbs or in questions for talking about something that has not happened but that you expect to happen.
 
• 
 
 
• Example:* **Has it stopped raining **yet**?*
 
 
 
• *​*An infinitive verb is essentially the base form of a verb with the word** "to" **in front of it.
 
• When you use an infinitive verb, the "to" is a part of the verb.
 
• The structure 'to + V1' to show that the next word is an infinitive verb.
 
 
• Example:* **I want to go there.*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore, the use of **'yet living****'** in the sentence should be replaced with 'yet to live' to make it grammatically correct.​
 
• The correct sentence__:* **We are **yet to live **in the same house.​*

*​ * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• The past indefinite tense, also known as simple past tense, is used to indicate a finished or completed action/task that occurred/happened at a specific point in time in the past. 

 
 
• Structure: Subject + verb in the past form + . . . . . + adverb of time + . . . . .
 
• Example: *I ate a mango a few minutes ago.*
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__***

__
 
• भाग 'yet living' गलत है क्योंकि यह व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है।
 
• शब्द 'yet' का प्रयोग नकारात्मक क्रियाओं के साथ या प्रश्नों में किसी ऐसी बात के बारे में बात करने के लिए किया जाता है जो हुआ नहीं है लेकिन आप होने की उम्मीद करते हैं।
 
• 
 
 
• Example:* **Has it stopped raining yet?*
 
 
 
• एक इनफिनिटिव क्रिया अनिवार्य रूप से एक क्रिया का मूल रूप है जिसके सामने **"to"** शब्द होता है।
 
• जब आप एक अपरिमेय क्रिया का उपयोग करते हैं, तो "to" क्रिया का एक भाग होता है।
 
• संरचना 'to + V1' यह दिखाने के लिए कि अगला शब्द एक अपरिमेय क्रिया है।
 
 
• Example:* **I want to go there.*
 
 
 
• इसलिए, व्याकरण की दृष्टि से इसे सही बनाने के लिए वाक्य में 'yet living' के उपयोग को 'yet to live' से बदल दिया जाना चाहिए।

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__Unless someone makes a complaint,__ they will not clear the garbage from the street.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'No substitution required​.'**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• We use unless to say except if.
 
• **Unless** is a conditional word (like if), so we don’t use will or would in the subordinate clause:
 
 
• Example: *You can't get a job unless you have experience.​*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'No substitution required​.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• In references to the future with when, we use the present simple or the present perfect in the when-clause, not the future with shall and will

 
 
• Example: *When the new park opens, I’ll go there every day.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• हम जब तक कहने के लिए unless उपयोग करते हैं।
 
• Unless एक सशर्त शब्द नहीं है (जैसे अगर), तो हम अधीनस्थ खंड में वसीयत या इच्छा का उपयोग नहीं करेंगे:
 
 
• Example: *You can't get a job unless you have experience.​*

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Mother said, “All the guests will arrive tonight."

options.text: Mother said that all the guests will arrive tonight.
Mother said that all the guests would arrive that night
Mother said that all the guests will arrive that night.
Mother told that all the guests would arrive tonight.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'****Mother said that all the guests would arrive that night.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The rules for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in **Future Simple Tense**.
 
• **'Will' changes to 'Would.'**
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed in told, asked, demanded, ordered, enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• Remove the commas and inverted commas.
 
• The first person in reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• Use that in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
 
• Example: *Shakespeare said, “I will write another drama tomorrow.” *(Direct speech)

 * Shakespeare said that he would write another drama the next day.* (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• If the sentence of Direct speech has a question that cannot be answered by saying yes or no then it does not use “if” or “whether” in its Indirect speech.

 
 
• Example: * **She said to me, “Where did you buy this dress from?” *(Direct speech)

 * **She asked me where I had bought that dress from. *(Indirect speech)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• Direct Speech को Indirect Speech में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Future Simple Tense में है।
 
• Will, Would में बदल जाता है।
 
• Said/said to रिपोर्टिंग verb वाक्य की प्रकृति के अनुसार asked, demanded, ordered, enquired में बदल जाती है।
 
• Commas और inverted commas हटा दे।
 
• Reported speech में first person, reporting speech के subject के अनुसार बदलता है।
 
• Indirect speech के वाक्य में that का प्रयोग करें।
 
 
• Example: *Shakespeare said, “I will write another drama tomorrow.” *(Direct speech)

 * Shakespeare said that he would write another drama the next day.* (Indirect speech)

questions.question:
**Direction: Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. His school was closed as it was the height of summer.

B. It was on one such day that Ranji discovered a pool in the forest.

C. As he had no friends yet, he wandered alone in the hills and forests.

D. Ranji had been less than a month in Rajpur.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'DACB.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While arranging the parts of the passage given in options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them__, so let’s find out. 

 __
 
• The opener will be **D** as it introduces the context of the paragraph.
 
• After this, **A** will come as it adds information about the school of Ranji.
 
• After this, **C **will come as it is saying that Ranji is not having friends.
 
• B follows C as B talks about the discovery of a pool.
 
• The last sentence will be B as it is providing a conclusion to the context.
 
 
 
• ​​The correct sequence__:

 ​

D. Ranji had been less than a month in Rajpur.

A. His school was closed as it was the height of summer.

C. As he had no friends yet, he wandered alone in the hills and forests.

B. It was on one such day that Ranji discovered a pool in the forest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• Steps for solving Para Jumbles:
 
 
• Clues include pronouns, like he, she, it, this, that, these, those; adverbs like formally, really; article a, an and the; definers like actually, finally, another; connectors like but, yet, both, also and neither nor, or, however, nevertheless.
 
• Now, with the help of clues, try to find out qualifier and qualified sentences, so that we can make pairs of qualified and qualifier sentences to eliminate the wrong choices given in the question.
 
• After making pairs, start eliminating the wrong choices or options given in the question.
 
• In case there is more than one choice, try to follow the sequence of sentences according to the occurrence of the events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 

__
 
• विकल्पों में दिए गए गद्यांश के भागों को व्यवस्थित करते समय, हमें उनके बीच कुछ व्याकरणिक या प्रासंगिक संबंध खोजने होंगे, तो आइए जानें।
 
 
• Opener, D होगा क्योंकि यह पैराग्राफ के संदर्भ का परिचय देता है।
 
• इसके बाद, A आएगा क्योंकि यह रणजी के स्कूल के बारे में जानकारी जोड़ता है।
